I assume the problem here is that passing `0xffff` as the port to `UriParser.Register` is invalid:
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/8006e6a89bc02e410331e6323e3f6321b224b327/src/libraries/System.Private.Uri/src/System/UriScheme.cs#L177-L178
and the test does so every 1/2^16 runs:
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/fe50d91a99dc17f8b3cbbb18103a7e8dca051075/src/libraries/System.Private.Uri/tests/FunctionalTests/UriCreationOptionsTest.cs#L218

Not sure whether the test is wrong or `UriParser.Register` is wrong, so will defer to area owner on this.
